title: The public API refuses to create a part whose number already exists
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-APIDUP-01) is active and tracked at {Location-A}.
  • A connected system has tried to create a part numbered {Part-A} through ShopView's public API. This cannot be done in the ShopView screens.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Type {Part-A} in the Search box.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 2: {Part-A} is listed exactly once: no second part with that number was created.
  • Steps 1 and 2: The refusal itself is seen only by the connected system: write "public API refusal not checked by hand" in the result comment. If no connected system made the attempt, also mark the case Blocked.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10822 (Story 9, Inactive Parts Cannot Be Added to New Work); story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S9-E9, S11-E3, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas: no board shows this behaviour (13 Oct copy). Tech plan "Parts Lifecycle Update — Technical Implementation Plan" (7 Oct 2026), §5 API Changes. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).
